header: One tick per period, typed by an editor
lead: A published record, not a live monitor. Ticks are coloured by status, because at typical availability figures every tick looks almost full.
note: Example figures for a library’s online catalogue, April to September 2026, measured from outside its network. Every period with a comment is repeated under the strip, so incidents stay visible.
